headline: Field RUM now filters lifecycle noise before making performance claims.

items.title: RUM field truth contract
items.insight: The field-performance alert was not trustworthy enough to chase as a rendering bug. The beacon, Worker, and rollup now carry and enforce usable foreground navigation context before any field verdict is authoritative.

items.title: Honest performance deferral
items.insight: Corrected RUM has 27 usable samples and 0 sufficient routes, so homepage LCP and Football GM INP remain evidence-gated instead of being falsely closed or falsely treated as confirmed current regressions.

items.title: Full suite green
items.insight: The generated shell and public proof feeds were refreshed, stale shell output was cleaned, and the full 181-step build-check plus doctor stayed blocking-clean.

followUps: Let corrected RUM accrue enough usable post-deploy samples before claiming homepage LCP or Football GM INP closure.
Verify post-push CI/deploy after the direct main push.
